texts.home.welcome.body: HEBS brings together the beauty industry's professionals, educators, innovators, entrepreneurs and emerging talent. For the first time, the whole experience takes place at one destination on the Atlantic: three days of learning, competition, business and celebration.

texts.seo.aboutDescription: The Hair Education Beauty Summit: its history, mission and vision, from its United States editions to Lagos.
texts.welcome.body: HEBS brings together the beauty industry's professionals, educators, innovators, entrepreneurs and emerging talents. For three days in Lagos, the summit is built around education, professional development, excellence, collaboration and opportunity.
texts.experience.headline: THE HEBS EXPERIENCE
texts.experience.items.0.body: Hair education, technical training and live demonstrations led by working professionals.
texts.experience.items.1.body: Competitions that recognise talent, creativity and technical excellence across every category.
texts.experience.items.2.body: Brands and businesses presenting products, tools and services to the professionals who use them.
texts.experience.items.3.body: Built to bring together beauty professionals from Nigeria, across Africa, the United States, Europe and beyond.
texts.experience.items.4.body: An opening celebration, live moments on stage and closing celebrations across the three days.
texts.experience.items.5.body: A resort on the Atlantic coast that brings the whole summit together in one destination.
texts.destination.body: For the first time, the entire HEBS experience takes place at NJS Beach Resort, on the Atlantic coast of Lagos: education, competitions, exhibitions, networking and celebrations in one destination.
texts.pages.experience.intro: Three days at NJS Beach Resort, and six experiences that run through them: education, competitions, exhibitions, networking, celebrations and the destination itself.
texts.pages.experience.more.exp-education: Hair education, technical training, live demonstrations, beauty business development and professional masterclasses: the summit's strongest foundation.
texts.pages.experience.more.exp-exhibitions: Brands and businesses showing products, tools and services to the professionals who choose and use them.
texts.pages.experience.more.exp-networking: Beauty professionals, educators, entrepreneurs and brands from Nigeria, across Africa, the United States, Europe and beyond, in one place for three days.
texts.pages.experience.more.exp-destination: For the first time, the whole summit takes place at one resort on the Atlantic coast, so education, competitions and celebrations share one destination.
texts.pages.travel.venue: For the first time, the entire HEBS experience takes place at NJS Beach Resort, on the Atlantic coast of Lagos.
texts.pages.travel.developmentNote: NJS Beach Resort is still being completed. Facilities in development are listed with their opening dates once NJS confirms them. Rooms are not offered through this website until their opening and booking arrangements are confirmed.
texts.pages.travel.developmentCaption: Development update. Construction in progress, not a completed facility.
texts.pages.travel.accommodation: Special HEBS accommodation and hospitality packages at NJS Beach Resort are being explored and will be introduced once officially approved.
texts.pages.travel.faqs.2.a: HEBS accommodation packages at the resort are introduced once approved. Until then, no room or package is offered through this website.
texts.pages.gallery.winnersNote: HEBS Lagos 2026 prize presentations. Results subject to final verification.
texts.pages.about.next: In 2027, for the first time, the entire HEBS experience takes place at one destination: NJS Beach Resort, on the Atlantic coast of Lagos.
texts.pages.about.pillars.0.body: Providing beauty and industry professionals with world-class technical training, mentorship programs, and immediate access to the latest global trends and product innovations.
texts.pages.about.pillars.1.body: Creating a dynamic global network and physical hub where hairstylists, masters barbers, creative makeup artists, fashion stylists, educators, and global brand leaders can seamlessly collaborate, share narratives, and grow collectively.
texts.pages.about.pillars.2.body: Ensuring that the collective future of beauty, grooming, and high-fashion remains completely inclusive, boundary-pushing, hyper-innovative, and continuously driven by technical excellence.
texts.pages.speakers.teach: Interested in teaching at HEBS 2027? Speakers and educators are confirmed by the HEBS team; the 2027 priority list, opening soon, is the way to hear first.

texts.pages.education.intro: Professional education is one of HEBS's strongest foundations. The 2027 programme is planned around five areas of learning.
texts.pages.education.tracks.0.body: Cutting, colour, styling and care, taught by working professionals.
texts.pages.education.tracks.1.body: Hands-on technique for stylists, barbers and beauty professionals who want to sharpen their craft.
texts.pages.education.tracks.2.body: Techniques shown live on stage, from first step to finished look.
texts.pages.education.tracks.3.body: Building, running and growing a beauty business: clients, pricing, brand and team.
texts.pages.education.tracks.4.body: Focused sessions with leading educators for professionals ready for the next level.
texts.pages.competitions.eligibility: Who may enter each competition, and what competitors must bring, is published with the 2027 rules.
texts.pages.competitions.rules: The 2027 rules for every competition, including timing, judging and conduct, are published once approved.
texts.pages.competitions.apply: Applications open through the HEBS 2027 registration portal once the 2027 rules, entry fees and deadlines are approved.
texts.pages.competitions.awards: Every competition carries a prize, and 2027 prize values are the same as 2026. Amounts are shown here once the 2027 currency presentation is approved.
texts.pages.tickets.pricesNote: Prices are in naira. Tickets are sold only through the official HEBS Lagos booking portal, once sales open.
texts.partners.body: Sponsorship, exhibition, brand activation and strategic partnership opportunities for businesses that want to reach the beauty industry in Lagos and beyond.
texts.partners.pathways.0.body: Put your brand beside the summit's education, competitions and celebrations.
texts.partners.pathways.1.body: Show products, tools and services to the professionals who choose them.
texts.partners.pathways.2.body: Create moments guests take part in, at the resort and on stage.
texts.partners.pathways.3.body: Build a longer relationship with HEBS and its professional community.
texts.partners.gate: Partner inquiries and the 2027 sponsorship prospectus open once approved.
texts.pages.sponsorship.intro: Sponsorship, exhibition, brand activation and strategic partnership opportunities for businesses that want to reach beauty professionals in Lagos and beyond.
texts.pages.sponsorship.steps.0.body: Choose how you want to take part: sponsorship, exhibition, brand activation or a strategic partnership.
texts.pages.sponsorship.steps.1.body: Tell the HEBS team about your brand and what you want to achieve.
texts.pages.sponsorship.steps.2.body: The 2027 sponsorship prospectus, with packages, is sent once it is approved.
texts.pages.sponsorship.steps.3.body: You receive confirmation that your inquiry has arrived, and the team follows up.
texts.pages.exhibitors.intro: Show your products, tools and services to beauty professionals across three days at NJS Beach Resort.
texts.pages.exhibitors.opportunities.0.body: A place on the exhibition floor to meet professionals and present your range.
texts.pages.exhibitors.opportunities.1.body: Present a launch, a collection or a service to the summit audience.
texts.pages.exhibitors.opportunities.2.body: Create a moment guests take part in, at the resort or on stage.
